env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
export HOME="$TMPDIR/home"
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$TMPDIR/run"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$HOME/.cache" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$HOME/.config"
export XDG_DATA_HOME="$HOME/.local/share" XDG_STATE_HOME="$HOME/.local/state"
# node-gyp builds native addons against these headers rather than
# downloading them.
export npm_config_nodedir=/nix/store/6vlx51wp6rjcsb1gcx54hfb7ndf3k2h8-nodejs-24.21.0

mkdir -p "$HOME" "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
cp --no-preserve=mode /nix/store/475sfjrgamsylcrpmv3mdvmxfzzi0ig7-pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-lock.yaml
node /nix/store/dxkmxp76id8xb5is1bk4790i4vhihchs-npm-input-lock.mjs pnpm-lock.yaml
patchShebangs --build .
node /nix/store/ap5z7xhf0nrvyn43zsq5am5kfz8iyxkv-src/pnpm-purifier.mjs registry-exec --manifest /nix/store/9rcvsskvyzncm1ki8f2a77i7hi1yyx5b-pnpm-purifier-registry.json --registries /nix/store/7dgdi3i2w977hprm9ni4gsi4z1d89349-pnpm-purifier-registries.json --pin-project . -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir "$TMPDIR/store" 
for modules in $(find . -name node_modules -type d -prune); do
  patchShebangs --build "$modules"
done
node /nix/store/ap5z7xhf0nrvyn43zsq5am5kfz8iyxkv-src/pnpm-purifier.mjs registry-exec --manifest /nix/store/9rcvsskvyzncm1ki8f2a77i7hi1yyx5b-pnpm-purifier-registry.json --registries /nix/store/7dgdi3i2w977hprm9ni4gsi4z1d89349-pnpm-purifier-registries.json --pin-project . -- bash -euo pipefail -c 'pnpm --recursive run --if-present build
pnpm --recursive run --if-present test
'

runHook postBuild
env.name: workspace-root-tests
